blocks.text: British indie-pop four-piece PREP is making their highly anticipated return to Manila for another night of smooth grooves, infectious melodies, and their signature blend of jazz, soul, West Coast pop, and Japanese City Pop. Formed in London in 2015, PREP is composed of Thom Havelock (vocals), Llywelyn Ap Myrddin (keys), Guillaume Jambel (drums), and Dan Radclyffe (production). Over the past decade, the band has developed a distinct sound that blends nostalgic influences with contemporary pop, earning them a dedicated following around the world.
